Multi-session key-indistinguishability game infrastructure for PQXDH

Trusted: the statement. Defines the multi-session key-indistinguishability (KeyInd) oracle types and handler (KeyIndQuery, KeyIndResponse, KeyIndState, pqxdhKeyIndImpl), freshness predicates (isKeyIndInitStillFresh, isKeyIndRespStillFresh), replication bounds (Setup), and query budgets (QueryBudget) used by Security/Headline.lean, Security/HeadlineDelta.lean, and Assumptions/{KeyInd1KeyReal,KeyInd1KeyRo}.lean. See Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md.

Honest parties execute the PQXDH handshake model of LibsignalBinary/Specifications/SignalPqxdh/Model.lean (Model.acceptKeys, buildSecrets) over abstract Primitives while the adversary controls the network, schedules sessions, corrupts identity keys, and reveals signed pre-key secrets. Game structure and freshness clauses follow the CryptoVerif model PQXDH.m4.ocv of BJKS24 (Bhargavan, Jacomme, Kiefer, Schmidt, USENIX Security 2024; see Computational/docs/README.md).

Key modelling choices (Computational/docs/DEVIATIONS.md):

  • One-key identities. The headline experiments (KeyInd1KeyReal.lean, KeyInd1KeyRo.lean) override .initPrin to derive both X25519 (secIKA0) and XEdDSA (secIKAsign) from a single 32-byte scalar; PrincipalEntry retains separate fields so the standalone two-key game can share the remaining handlers.

  • Handshake KDF (DEV-PQ14). useRo = true models HkdfRO as a lazy caching random oracle; useRo = false evaluates P.hkdfDerive96.

  • Known-secret-key (KOSK) registration (DEV-PQ15). Adversarial X25519 identity, signed, and one-time pre-keys supplied to honest sessions must be registered with their secret scalar via registerKey (or be game-generated keys of the same role), weakening the model by restricting the adversary.

  • Canonical ephemeral keys (DEV-PQ16). Responders reject non-canonical X25519 ephemeral keys ekAPk.

Uniform byte sampling

def word256ToBytesL59–61 ↗#

Little-endian 32-byte encoding of w.

def word256ToBytes (w : BitVec 256) : Bytes := List.ofFn (fun (i : Fin 32) => UInt8.ofNat ((w.toNat >>> (8 * i.val)) % 256))

def word128ToBytesL63–65 ↗#

Little-endian 16-byte encoding of w.

def word128ToBytes (w : BitVec 128) : Bytes := List.ofFn (fun (i : Fin 16) => UInt8.ofNat ((w.toNat >>> (8 * i.val)) % 256))

def sampleCoins32 : ProbComp Bytes := sampleBytes32

Replication bounds and session identifiers

structure SetupL99–108 ↗#

Multi-user, multi-session replication bounds on principals, pre-key bundles, one-time pre-keys, and sessions (PQXDH.m4.ocv).

structure Setup where N_id : Nat -- max honest principals (`initPrin`) N_recv : Nat -- max SPK + PQSPK bundles per principal (`genSPK`) N_opk : Nat -- max OPKs / `recvOPK` sessions per bundle (`genOPK`) N_no_opk : Nat -- max `recvNoOPK` sessions per bundle N_send_opk : Nat -- max initiator With-OPK sessions per principal N_send_no_opk : Nat -- max initiator No-OPK sessions per principal deriving DecidableEq, Repr
namespace Setup

def N_spk_totL112 ↗#

def N_spk_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_id * S.N_recv

def N_opk_totL114 ↗#

def N_opk_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_spk_tot * S.N_opk

def N_no_opk_totL116 ↗#

def N_no_opk_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_spk_tot * S.N_no_opk

def N_recv_totL118 ↗#

def N_recv_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_opk_tot + S.N_no_opk_tot

def N_send_opk_totL120 ↗#

def N_send_opk_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_id * S.N_send_opk

def N_send_no_opk_totL122 ↗#

def N_send_no_opk_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_id * S.N_send_no_opk

def N_send_totL124 ↗#

def N_send_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_send_opk_tot + S.N_send_no_opk_tot

def N_sess_totL126 ↗#

def N_sess_tot (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_send_tot + S.N_recv_tot

def N_dhL128–129 ↗#

Total honestly generated X25519 keypairs across the game.

def N_dh (S : Setup) : Nat := S.N_id + S.N_spk_tot + S.N_opk_tot + S.N_send_tot
end Setup

inductive SessionIdL133–140 ↗#

Session slot identifier for initiator (sendOPK, sendNoOPK) and responder (recvOPK, recvNoOPK) sessions.

inductive SessionId (S : Setup) where | sendOPK (u : Fin S.N_id) (i : Fin S.N_send_opk) | sendNoOPK (u : Fin S.N_id) (i : Fin S.N_send_no_opk) | recvOPK (k : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) (o : Fin S.N_opk) | recvNoOPK (k : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) (l : Fin S.N_no_opk) deriving DecidableEq, Repr

Principal, bundle, and pre-key state

structure PrincipalEntryL144–153 ↗#

State of an initialized honest principal u : Fin S.N_id. The one-key headline games set secIKAsign := secIKA0 and ikSignPk := ikAPk from a single scalar; the fields remain separate so the standalone two-key game can share pqxdhKeyIndImpl.

structure PrincipalEntry where secIKA0 : Bytes -- 32B X25519 identity secret scalar ikAPk : Bytes -- 32B wire identity public key secIKAsign : Bytes -- 32B XEdDSA signing secret scalar ikSignPk : Bytes -- 32B XEdDSA verification public key corrupted : Bool -- true iff `corruptIK u` has been called deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure SpkBundleEntryL155–164 ↗#

Honestly generated signed EC pre-key and Kyber-1024 pre-key bundle (u, j).

structure SpkBundleEntry where spkSk : Bytes -- 32B `SPK_B.sk` spkPk : Bytes -- 32B `SPK_B.pk` spkSig : Bytes -- 64B XEdDSA signature over `encodeEC spkPk` pqspkSk : Bytes -- 3168B `PQSPK_B.sk` pqspkPk : Bytes -- 1568B `PQSPK_B.pk` pqspkSig : Bytes -- 64B XEdDSA signature over `encodeKEM pqspkPk` revealed : Bool := false -- true once `revealSpkSk u j` has been queried deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure OpkEntryL166–171 ↗#

Honestly generated one-time EC pre-key (u, j, o).

structure OpkEntry where opkSk : Bytes -- 32B `OPK_B.sk` opkPk : Bytes -- 32B `OPK_B.pk` consumed : Bool -- true once consumed by `acceptOPK` deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def findHonestPrincipalL173–176 ↗#

First honest principal whose ikAPk matches ikB modulo the cofactor projection pow8.

def findHonestPrincipal (P : Primitives) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (ikB : Bytes) : Option (Nat × PrincipalEntry) := principals.find? (fun (_, entry) => P.pow8 ikB == P.pow8 entry.ikAPk)

def resolveSigPkL178–183 ↗#

XEdDSA verification key for ikB: entry.ikSignPk if ikB belongs to an honest principal, and ikB otherwise.

def resolveSigPk (P : Primitives) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (ikB : Bytes) : Bytes := match findHonestPrincipal P principals ikB with | some (_, entry) => entry.ikSignPk | none => ikB

def isHonestUncorruptedPeerL185–190 ↗#

Index of the honest principal matching ikB if currently uncorrupted, or none.

def isHonestUncorruptedPeer (P : Primitives) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (ikB : Bytes) : Option Nat := match findHonestPrincipal P principals ikB with | some (k, entry) => if !entry.corrupted then some k else none | none => none

def checkBundleProvenanceL192–212 ↗#

Whether (spkB, opkB?, pqspkB) in bundle were honestly generated by the principal owning bundle.ikB (with EC keys compared modulo pow8).

def checkBundleProvenance (P : Primitives) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry)) (opkEntries : List ((Nat × Nat × Nat) × OpkEntry)) (bundle : PreKeyBundleInput) : Bool × Bool × Bool := match findHonestPrincipal P principals bundle.ikB with | none => (false, false, false) | some (k, _) => let spkHon := spkBundles.any (fun ((u, _), b) => u == k && P.pow8 b.spkPk == P.pow8 bundle.spkB) let pqspkHon := spkBundles.any (fun ((u, _), b) => u == k && b.pqspkPk == bundle.pqspkB) let opkHon := match bundle.opkB? with | none => false | some (_, opkPk) => opkEntries.any (fun ((u, _, _), e) => u == k && P.pow8 e.opkPk == P.pow8 opkPk) (spkHon, opkHon, pqspkHon)

Known-secret-key (KOSK) registration (DEV-PQ15)

Every X25519 public key supplied to an honest session in an identity, signed-pre-key, or one-time-pre-key position must either be a game-generated key of the same role or be registered with its 32-byte secret scalar via registerKey sk (all comparisons modulo pow8; ekAPk and pqspkB are unrestricted). Without KOSK, adversarial keys with unknown discrete logs induce a 4-point DH relation on DH1 that a 3-point GapDH oracle cannot test. Registration weakens the model by disallowing unregistered unknown-secret public keys, while remaining pure bookkeeping that does not mark keys honest or affect freshness or partnering.

def isAdvRegisteredL224–225 ↗#

def isAdvRegistered (P : Primitives) (advKeys : List (Bytes × Bytes)) (pk : Bytes) : Bool := advKeys.any (fun (_, pk') => P.pow8 pk == P.pow8 pk')

def isGameIdKeyL227–228 ↗#

def isGameIdKey (P : Primitives) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (pk : Bytes) : Bool := (findHonestPrincipal P principals pk).isSome

def isGameSpkL230–232 ↗#

def isGameSpk (P : Primitives) (spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry)) (pk : Bytes) : Bool := spkBundles.any (fun (_, b) => P.pow8 b.spkPk == P.pow8 pk)

def isGameOpkL234–236 ↗#

def isGameOpk (P : Primitives) (opkEntries : List ((Nat × Nat × Nat) × OpkEntry)) (pk : Bytes) : Bool := opkEntries.any (fun (_, e) => P.pow8 e.opkPk == P.pow8 pk)

def koskBundleOkL238–248 ↗#

Role-strict KOSK check on an initiator's peer bundle (ikB, spkB, and opkB? modulo pow8).

def koskBundleOk (P : Primitives) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry)) (opkEntries : List ((Nat × Nat × Nat) × OpkEntry)) (advKeys : List (Bytes × Bytes)) (bundle : PreKeyBundleInput) : Bool := (isGameIdKey P principals bundle.ikB || isAdvRegistered P advKeys bundle.ikB) && (isGameSpk P spkBundles bundle.spkB || isAdvRegistered P advKeys bundle.spkB) && (match bundle.opkB? with | none => true | some (_, opkPk) => isGameOpk P opkEntries opkPk || isAdvRegistered P advKeys opkPk)

def koskSenderOkL250–253 ↗#

Role-strict KOSK check on a responder's claimed sender identity key ikAPk.

def koskSenderOk (P : Primitives) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (advKeys : List (Bytes × Bytes)) (ikAPk : Bytes) : Bool := isGameIdKey P principals ikAPk || isAdvRegistered P advKeys ikAPk

def registerAdvKeyL255–261 ↗#

Register a 32-byte adversarial secret scalar sk as (P.x25519Base sk, (sk, pk) :: advKeys).

def registerAdvKey (P : Primitives) (advKeys : List (Bytes × Bytes)) (sk : Bytes) : Option (Bytes × List (Bytes × Bytes)) := if sk.length != 32 then none else let pk := P.x25519Base sk some (pk, (sk, pk) :: advKeys)

def evalHkdfOrRoL263–274 ↗#

Evaluate the 96-byte handshake KDF via the lazy caching random oracle roCache when useRo = true (DEV-PQ14) or via P.hkdfDerive96 when useRo = false.

def evalHkdfOrRo (useRo : Bool) (P : Primitives) (roCache : List (Bytes × DRKey)) (secrets : Bytes) : ProbComp (DRKey × List (Bytes × DRKey)) := do if !useRo then return (P.hkdfDerive96 secrets, roCache) else match roCache.find? (fun (s, _) => s == secrets) with | some (_, dk) => return (dk, roCache) | none => let dk ← sampleDRKey96 return (dk, (secrets, dk) :: roCache)

def checkAndMarkKyberBaseKeySeenL276–285 ↗#

Insert (k, pqspkId, spkId, ekAPk) into Bob's seen-base-key set if absent; the Bool result is true iff the tuple is fresh.

def checkAndMarkKyberBaseKeySeen (usedTriples : List (Nat × KeyId × KeyId × Bytes)) (k : Nat) (pqspkId spkId : KeyId) (ekAPk : Bytes) : Bool × List (Nat × KeyId × KeyId × Bytes) := let entry := (k, pqspkId, spkId, ekAPk) if usedTriples.contains entry then (false, usedTriples) else (true, entry :: usedTriples)

Key-indistinguishability game (KeyInd)

structure KeyIndInitiatorEntryL289–307 ↗#

Initiator session record in KeyInd.

structure KeyIndInitiatorEntry (S : Setup) where sid : SessionId S honestPeer : Option Nat -- `some k` iff target `ikB` was honest and uncorrupted at initiation time peerIkPk : Bytes peerSpkPk : Bytes peerOpkPk? : Option Bytes peerPqspkPk : Bytes spkHonest : Bool opkHonest : Bool pqspkHonest : Bool ekASk : Bytes fresh : Bool drKeyReal : DRKey drKeyRand : DRKey hdr : HandshakeHdr tested : Bool -- true once `testSession sid` has been queried revealed : Bool := false -- true once `revealSessionKey sid` has been queried deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure KeyIndRespEntryL309–322 ↗#

Responder session record in KeyInd, created on successful acceptOPK or acceptNoOPK.

structure KeyIndRespEntry (S : Setup) where sid : SessionId S respIkPk : Bytes -- responder's wire identity key spkPk : Bytes -- responder's SPK used opkPk? : Option Bytes -- responder's OPK used (if any) pqspkPk : Bytes -- responder's PQSPK used hdr : HandshakeHdr -- received header senderHonest : Bool drKeyReal : DRKey drKeyRand : DRKey tested : Bool := false revealed : Bool := false deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def keyIndPartnerL324–335 ↗#

Partnering between initiator session s and responder session r: agreement on all KDF-determining keys (ikAPk, peerIkPk/respIkPk, spkPk, and opkPk? modulo pow8, plus byte-exact ekAPk, pqspkPk, and kemCt). Malleable header key IDs are ignored.

def keyIndPartner {S : Setup} (P : Primitives) (s : KeyIndInitiatorEntry S) (r : KeyIndRespEntry S) : Bool := P.pow8 s.hdr.ikAPk == P.pow8 r.hdr.ikAPk && P.pow8 s.peerIkPk == P.pow8 r.respIkPk && P.pow8 s.peerSpkPk == P.pow8 r.spkPk && s.peerOpkPk?.map P.pow8 == r.opkPk?.map P.pow8 && s.hdr.ekAPk == r.hdr.ekAPk && s.peerPqspkPk == r.pqspkPk && s.hdr.kemCt == r.hdr.kemCt

def isSpkRevealedL337–341 ↗#

Whether pk matches (modulo pow8) a game-generated SPK whose secret was revealed via revealSpkSk.

def isSpkRevealed (P : Primitives) (spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry)) (pk : Bytes) : Bool := spkBundles.any (fun (_, b) => b.revealed && P.pow8 b.spkPk == P.pow8 pk)

def keyIndInitCorruptionClauseL343–358 ↗#

Post-game key-compromise freshness clause for an initiator session s that was fresh at initiation (s.fresh = true):

  • Classical (useRo = true): either the peer identity key remains uncorrupted, an unrevealed honest SPK was used, or an honest OPK was used (pqspkHonest is excluded because the classical bound does not assume KEM IND-CCA).

  • Post-quantum HNDL (useRo = false, where .revealDhSecrets exposes X25519 scalars): s.pqspkHonest.

def keyIndInitCorruptionClause {S : Setup} (P : Primitives) (useRo : Bool) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry)) (s : KeyIndInitiatorEntry S) : Bool := s.fresh && (if useRo then (isHonestUncorruptedPeer P principals s.peerIkPk).isSome || (s.spkHonest && !isSpkRevealed P spkBundles s.peerSpkPk) || s.opkHonest else s.pqspkHonest)

def isKeyIndInitStillFreshL360–368 ↗#

End-of-game freshness of a tested initiator session s: keyIndInitCorruptionClause holds, s is unrevealed, and every partnered responder session is unrevealed with senderHonest = true (dishonest-sender accepts return .drKeyResp immediately).

def isKeyIndInitStillFresh {S : Setup} (P : Primitives) (useRo : Bool) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry)) (respSessions : List (KeyIndRespEntry S)) (s : KeyIndInitiatorEntry S) : Bool := keyIndInitCorruptionClause P useRo principals spkBundles s && !s.revealed && respSessions.all (fun r => !(keyIndPartner P s r) || (r.senderHonest && !r.revealed))

def isKeyIndRespStillFreshL370–385 ↗#

End-of-game freshness of a tested responder session r: r is unrevealed with r.senderHonest = true, and if r has any partnered initiator session then every partner is unrevealed and satisfies keyIndInitCorruptionClause; otherwise (unpartnered) useRo = true, the claimed sender remains uncorrupted, and r.spkPk has not been revealed via revealSpkSk.

def isKeyIndRespStillFresh {S : Setup} (P : Primitives) (useRo : Bool) (principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry)) (spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry)) (sessions : List (KeyIndInitiatorEntry S)) (r : KeyIndRespEntry S) : Bool := !r.revealed && r.senderHonest && (if sessions.any (fun s => keyIndPartner P s r) then sessions.all (fun s => !(keyIndPartner P s r) || (!s.revealed && keyIndInitCorruptionClause P useRo principals spkBundles s)) else useRo && (isHonestUncorruptedPeer P principals r.hdr.ikAPk).isSome && !isSpkRevealed P spkBundles r.spkPk)

inductive KeyIndQueryL387–405 ↗#

Oracle queries of the KeyInd game. Includes KOSK registration (registerKey, DEV-PQ15) and signed-pre-key secret reveal (revealSpkSk, used when composing with the Double Ratchet SM game where Bob's SPK serves as his initial ratchet key).

inductive KeyIndQuery (S : Setup) where | initPrin (u : Fin S.N_id) | corruptIK (u : Fin S.N_id) | genSPK (u : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) | genOPK (u : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) (o : Fin S.N_opk) | initiateOPK (u : Fin S.N_id) (i : Fin S.N_send_opk) (bundle : PreKeyBundleInput) | initiateNoOPK (u : Fin S.N_id) (i : Fin S.N_send_no_opk) (bundle : PreKeyBundleInput) | acceptOPK (k : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) (o : Fin S.N_opk) (hdr : HandshakeHdr) | acceptNoOPK (k : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) (l : Fin S.N_no_opk) (hdr : HandshakeHdr) | testSession (sid : SessionId S) | roQuery (secrets : Bytes) | revealDhSecrets | revealSessionKey (sid : SessionId S) | registerKey (sk : Bytes) -- KOSK registration (DEV-PQ15) | revealSpkSk (u : Fin S.N_id) (j : Fin S.N_recv) -- SPK secret reveal deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive KeyIndResponseL407–420 ↗#

Oracle responses of the KeyInd game.

inductive KeyIndResponse where | noneResp | initPrinResp (ikAPk ikSignPk : Bytes) | pkResp (pk : Bytes) | corrResp (ikSk sigSk : Bytes) | bundleResp (bundle : PreKeyBundleInput) | hdrResp (hdr : HandshakeHdr) | initUnfreshResp (drKey : DRKey) (hdr : HandshakeHdr) | acceptFreshResp | drKeyResp (drKey : DRKey) | dhSecretsResp (ikDhSks spkSks opkSks ekSks : List Bytes) | spkSkResp (spkSk : Bytes) deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def keyIndSpecL422–423 ↗#

@[reducible] def keyIndSpec (S : Setup) : OracleSpec (KeyIndQuery S) := fun _ => KeyIndResponse

structure KeyIndAdversaryL425–427 ↗#

Adversary in the KeyInd game.

structure KeyIndAdversary (S : Setup) where run : OracleComp (unifSpec + keyIndSpec S) Bool

structure KeyIndStateL429–441 ↗#

Mutable game state for KeyInd.

structure KeyIndState (S : Setup) where secb : Bool principals : List (Nat × PrincipalEntry) spkBundles : List ((Nat × Nat) × SpkBundleEntry) opkEntries : List ((Nat × Nat × Nat) × OpkEntry) sessions : List (KeyIndInitiatorEntry S) respSessions : List (KeyIndRespEntry S) := [] usedRecvOPK : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) usedRecvNoOPK : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) seenKyberBaseKeys : List (Nat × KeyId × KeyId × Bytes) roCache : List (Bytes × DRKey) advKeys : List (Bytes × Bytes) := [] -- registered `(sk, pk)` pairs (DEV-PQ15)

def KeyIndState.emptyL443–454 ↗#

def KeyIndState.empty (S : Setup) (secb : Bool) : KeyIndState S := { secb := secb principals := [] spkBundles := [] opkEntries := [] sessions := [] respSessions := [] usedRecvOPK := [] usedRecvNoOPK := [] seenKyberBaseKeys := [] roCache := [] advKeys := [] }

def isKeyIndSessionTestableL456–465 ↗#

Whether testSession sid is permitted: sid must be unrevealed, untested, and initiated toward an uncorrupted honest peer (e.fresh, initiator) or accepted from an honest claimed sender (r.senderHonest, responder).

def isKeyIndSessionTestable {S : Setup} (st : KeyIndState S) (sid : SessionId S) : Bool := match st.sessions.find? (fun e => e.sid == sid) with | some e => e.fresh && !e.tested && !e.revealed | none => match st.respSessions.find? (fun r => r.sid == sid) with | some r => r.senderHonest && !r.tested && !r.revealed | none => false

def recordKeyIndRespL467–475 ↗#

Record an accepted responder session; reuses a partnered initiator's drKeyRand when one exists so partnered sessions share one random-world key, and samples a fresh key otherwise.

def recordKeyIndResp (S : Setup) (P : Primitives) (r : KeyIndRespEntry S) : StateT (KeyIndState S) ProbComp Unit := do let st ← get let drKeyRand ← match st.sessions.find? (fun s => keyIndPartner P s r) with | some s => pure s.drKeyRand | none => liftM sampleDRKey96 set { st with respSessions := { r with drKeyRand := drKeyRand } :: st.respSessions }

def keyIndPartnerRandKey?L477–480 ↗#

Random-world key of an already recorded responder session partnered with s, if any.

def keyIndPartnerRandKey? {S : Setup} (P : Primitives) (respSessions : List (KeyIndRespEntry S)) (s : KeyIndInitiatorEntry S) : Option DRKey := (respSessions.find? (fun r => keyIndPartner P s r)).map (fun r => r.drKeyRand)

structure QueryBudgetL831–839 ↗#

Explicit oracle-query budget for a game adversary: q_ro HkdfRO queries, q_roRoot RootKdfRO queries, q_total total game-oracle queries (isGameQuery), and q_on online non-RO queries (isKeyIndOnlineQuery). Passed explicitly to reductions so they never inspect A.

structure QueryBudget where q_ro : Nat q_roRoot : Nat q_total : Nat q_on : Nat deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def isGameQueryL841–844 ↗#

True on game-oracle queries (.inr _) and false on uniform random sampling (.inl _).

def isGameQuery {ι : Type} : (Nat ⊕ ι) → Bool | .inr _ => true | .inl _ => false

def isGameQueryOfKindL846–850 ↗#

True on game-oracle queries .inr t of kind i (kind t = i) and false on uniform random sampling (.inl _); used to state per-kind query bounds (CostBoundedByKind).

def isGameQueryOfKind {ι : Type} {n : Nat} (kind : ι → Fin n) (i : Fin n) : (Nat ⊕ ι) → Bool | .inr t => decide (kind t = i) | .inl _ => false

class HasQueryBoundL852–855 ↗#

Typeclass asserting that an adversary A respects a QueryBudget together with the session-slot bounds from Setup.

class HasQueryBound (Adv : Type) where QueryBounded : Adv → QueryBudget → Prop
export HasQueryBound (QueryBounded)

instanceL859–865 ↗#

instance {S : Setup} : HasQueryBound (KeyIndAdversary S) where QueryBounded A b := OracleComp.IsQueryBoundP A.run isKeyIndRoQuery b.q_ro ∧ OracleComp.IsQueryBoundP A.run isKeyIndSendQuery S.N_send_tot ∧ OracleComp.IsQueryBoundP A.run isKeyIndRecvQuery S.N_recv_tot ∧ OracleComp.IsQueryBoundP A.run (fun q => isGameQuery q = true) b.q_total ∧ OracleComp.IsQueryBoundP A.run isKeyIndOnlineQuery b.q_on

def BoundedAdvL867–873 ↗#

Adversary paired with a proof that it respects query budget b. A has unrestricted computation steps; efficiency enters via explicit step-cost bounds on the reductions.

def BoundedAdv (Adv : Type) [HasQueryBound Adv] (b : QueryBudget) : Type := { A : Adv // QueryBounded A b }
end SignalPqxdh
